finding.evidence: HSTS ne couvre pas les sous-domaines (includeSubDomains absent).
finding.description: Ajoutez includeSubDomains si tous vos sous-domaines sont en HTTPS.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: missing-hsts (Ajoutez includeSubDomains si tous vos sous-domaines sont en HTTPS. Evidence: HSTS ne couvre pas les sous-domaines (includeSubDomains absent).). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix for missing includeSubDomains: use the HSTS example implementation `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains`. This single value fixes the reported evidence that HSTS does not cover subdomains.

sources.contribution: Here's an example of the HSTS header implementation: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
Here's an example of the HSTS header implementation: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

fix.summary: Add includeSubDomains to HSTS header to cover subdomains.
fix.risk: If an HTTP-only subdomain exists it would become forced to HTTPS.
